ETF Desk Monitor

 

Data retrieved Oct 12, 2026 from etfdb.com. Prices are closes of Oct 9, 2026 (delayed at least 15 minutes) and vary by fund. Daily prices are th.investing.com closes through Oct 9, 2026. The 38 non-US-listed funds (shown with their exchange), all total returns, and the yield and premium/discount gaps of the US funds come from TradingView screener exports of Oct 13, 2026, so those figures have a later as-of date than the etfdb data. For non-US funds the price is in the listing currency, AUM and flows are in USD, and holdings, sectors, price history and support and resistance are not available.

Universe summary

Size, cost, valuation, risk, flows and total return (1M, 3M and year to date) for all funds in the universe side by side, from ETFdb and TradingView. Shading ranks each fund within its column: red is lowest, green is highest, and the middle is unshaded. It shows rank only, so a red expense ratio or beta can be the better outcome. Daily rating is the Investing.com technical summary (TradingView's daily rating for non-US listings), shaded green for buy and red for sell. Each group shows its five largest funds; use Show all to expand a group, or sort a column to rank across the whole universe (top 20, then Show all). The table scrolls up and down inside its frame; on narrow screens some columns are hidden so it needs no side scroll. Click a heading to sort (again to reverse, a third time to return to groups) and click a row to open that fund. Returns are TradingView NAV total returns as of Oct 13, 2026; longer periods are in the ETF level.

Fund

Switch fund here, or pick a second fund in Compare with to see both side by side on every tab.

Net fund flows by period

Trailing net creations less redemptions, in $. Each bar covers the whole window ending now, so longer periods include the shorter ones.

Total return by period

All periods are TradingView net asset value total returns (dividends included) as of Oct 13, 2026, the same source and basis for every fund. 1M, 3M, YTD and 1Y are period returns, and 3Y is annualized from the 3-year return. 5Y has no total-return field, so it is the price return annualized (it excludes dividends). Funds ChinaAMC CSI 300 (83188, 3188) have price returns for 1M to 1Y and no 3Y. The benchmark is an iShares fund (ACWI global, URTH developed markets), not the fund's own index.

Holdings and allocation

Weights are % of fund. Choose a fund in the Fund screen above.

As of Oct 12, 2026. Sources: etfdb.com (fund data, holdings, returns, flows), th.investing.com (daily prices) and tradingview.com (non-US listings, filled gaps, Oct 13). Quotes are delayed at least 15 minutes. ETFdb average spread fields mix % and $ units, so spreads are left out. Not investment advice.
